regularConsistency.note: the sim's REPORTED win head must BE the analytic head — a gap beyond tie-decomposition noise is drift

knownHeadDivergence.note: margin-probit vs elo-logistic disagreement — a property of the two fitted heads, shipped as a visible diagnostic on every artifact (this release's own eval found it)

scoreMarginals2025Regular.note: coverage near 0.80 = honest widths; the naive gap is the margin head's contribution to scores

preseasonShrink.protocol: fit on 2023-24 preseason decisive games only; grid over [0.2,0.35,0.5,0.7,1]; tested once on 2025 preseason

honesty: the preseason variant is RESEARCH_ONLY: it widens and shrinks a regular-season fit; it does not model participation — player markets stay gated regardless
sigmaWiden 1.25 is a stated conservatism choice (unfit) — it widens intervals and cannot sharpen any claim
no market data touches the simulation; comparison happens beside it
